configurePresets.name: __release-base
configurePresets.description: Shared hidden base for the V0.1 release-validation surface. Forces Release buildType, disables experimental, telemetry, profiling, benchmarks, diagnostics. VCPKG manifest features = `tests`; defaults (cli, blend2d, text, mesh, exr) are merged automatically by vcpkg.

configurePresets.name: linux-release-validation
configurePresets.description: V0.1 release-only validation surface: CLI + text + Blend2D + software renderer + camera (via content) + install consumer + test obbligatori. Disables experimental / telemetry / profiling / benchmarks / diagnostics / expressions-v2. BuildType Release.
